one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent repeatedly ignored missing execution output (command not found in terminal output) and then claimed task completion based only on file existence and row counts, never verifying the evaluator-critical constraints of non-overlapping masks and correct coordinate serialization format.
t_err_evidence: At step 20 the agent runs the conversion script and receives '(command not found in terminal output)' but treats the absence of output as implicit success and plans to re-run rather than diagnosing the silent failure; this false belief (execution succeeded) is the earliest decisive mistake.
t_commit_evidence: At step 36 the agent sees the output file exists (5867 bytes) and asserts 'Fantastic! The script has successfully completed!' switching exclusively to cosmetic verification (row counts, type field), locking in the premature completion claim without any possibility of self-correction.
t_surface_evidence: Step 20 is the first occurrence of '(command not found in terminal output)' when running the conversion script, an observable signal that execution output was not captured; the same signal recurs at steps 23, 27, 29, 32, and 35.
trigger_explanation: The agent saw '(command not found in terminal output)' at six consecutive script execution attempts (steps 20, 23, 27, 29, 32, 35) but never investigated why execution output was absent. Instead it repeatedly re-ran the same command after installing each new dependency, treating the eventual appearance of the output file as proof of successful execution, without ever seeing a success message or processing log.
forewarning_evidence: Steps 20, 23, 27, 29, 32, and 35 all show '(command not found in terminal output)' for the identical script invocation command. The agent repeats the same command six times without resolving the missing output, a clear repeated-command forewarning pattern, and the empty/absent terminal output is an empty_or_unexpected_output signal.
fabrication_evidence: At step 36 the agent claims 'Fantastic! The script has successfully completed! It processed all 48 masks' based solely on the output file existing (ls -la demo_output.csv), even though no execution output was ever captured. The agent fabricates a narrative of successful processing that is not evidenced by any terminal output.
